title: Battle Monsters
overview:
There's a Rumble in Hell... and You're Invited.

Twelve psychotic monsters fight fist-and-fang in the darkest, goriest head-to-head combat ever! In bone-chilling interactive, multi-levelled environments, the beasts of the undead trade clawfuls of sickening supermoves in their bid to rule the underworld. Overflowing with guts, drool and slime, Battle Monsters is multi-hit, mid-air fighting blood lust... Feeling lucky, freak?
